item.title: How to read a monthly benchmark release
item.description: A guide to reading agentic test and validation results through task acceptance, evidence, cost, time, and reliability.

item.title: Automating CAN-based ECU tests with AI agents
item.description: Why a CAN or ECU test procedure is a lifecycle, not a single frame send, and how an agent-driven workflow keeps that lifecycle bounded and reviewable.

item.title: Running unattended ROS 2 hardware tests
item.description: Why most ROS 2 hardware testing is bottlenecked on a terminal and a person watching it, and what it takes to make a DDS-based test run unattended.

item.title: Why test automation still requires an engineer in the loop
item.description: Automation that stops at "run the script" still needs a person standing next to it — a look at where test automation actually breaks down and what closes the gap.
